form.timeout.disabled: Not available to turn off in this query type
context_limit-rows: Maximum number of result rows returned to the viewer
context_transaction-mode: Controls transaction isolation and whether the query can modify data
context_resource-pool: Choose the resource pool used to run the query. “No pool override” lets YDB select the pool automatically.
context_query-type: Selects the YDB API used to execute the query. Available features depend on the selected type.
context_tracing: Collects query execution traces for troubleshooting. The selected level controls how much detail is recorded.
context_output-chunk-max-size: Maximum size of a streamed result chunk, in bytes. Does not limit the total result size.
context_query-prefix: YQL statements added before each query, such as PRAGMA settings. The editor text stays unchanged.
context_stale-read-only-transaction-mode: Read operations within a transaction may return slightly outdated results
context_snapshot-read-only-transaction-m: All the read operations within a transaction access the database snapshot
